items.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... [INTERVIEWEE] Nice to be here, thank you.

ctx.x: I was telling Monk I’ve been wearing a hearing aid for about the last five years and yesterday it conked out on me, so everything sounds a little—
It’s not a good place to have things conk out on you. © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
